name: Explore a circuit simulation campaign
description: Loads the spikes of any circuit simulation campaign: point or detailed neurons, one or several node populations, any stimuli, and a scan over any number of parameters. On the platform it links the mounted files rather than downloading them. It shows the neurons and the circuit's connectivity, then the spikes: a raster of every simulation, an interactive raster with the stimuli and recorded traces, statistics of any selection of neurons across the scan, and tables, rasters and histograms by group.
